description: Repository identifier, never changed: EMA- and the record's position in the workbook (EMA-00001 is spreadsheet row 2)
Name of the enslaved person, as recorded
Age in years, as recorded; one impossible value (-1) set to NA
F or M; NA where not recorded
Occupation as recorded; 'Not Specified' where the source gives none; NA where the workbook reads 'NA' (76 records)
Place of origin as recorded (Cape = born in the colony); NA where not recorded
Compensation claim number, as used by the Legacies of British Slavery database (UCL); links people in one claim
Qualifier recorded with the owner's name (e.g. sr, jr, oorlede, Weduwee, 'sv' = son of)
1 if the owner is recorded as a minor
1 if the owner is recorded as deceased (the estate held the person)
Place of residence (farm or town), as recorded
Appraised value of the person, as recorded; pounds sterling, though some may be rixdollars; not converted

Compensation awarded for the claim (not the person), usually entered on one row of the claim, sometimes once per owner; 26 claims have more than one amount (see README); do not sum across people. Pounds sterling with shillings and pence as decimal fractions, as recorded
Notes in the workbook, including payment notes and source references such as BPP=5
